executiveSummary.title: WHAT THE DATA SAYS
executiveSummary.narrative:
Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo appeared in at least one AI answer for 42.9% of the traveler needs we tested, and across every individual AI answer it appeared 29% of the time. Together, these results show how broadly AI recognizes the hotel and how consistently a traveler would encounter it.

Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo appeared in the Top 3 18.8% of the time, showing how prominently it is positioned when AI includes it.

AI currently reflects 50% of the monitored facts and attributes that define the hotel, so important parts of the property proposition are not consistently represented in AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.

sections.headline: Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo's most important issue is concentrated competitive displacement by JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo, not a vague visibility problem.
sections.keyInsight: JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo appears in 35 monitored scenarios where Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo is absent. That concentration matters more than a long competitor list because it identifies a repeatable substitution pattern. Related Reality Gap pressure includes Full-Service Hotel at 4.1% recognition, which may help explain why the hotel is not carried into those answers.
sections.whyItMatters: Leadership needs to understand why specific alternatives are surfaced instead of Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo in recurring demand contexts. Otherwise attention may stay on average scores while missing the concentrated leak. A displacement pattern that repeats is more actionable than a soft overall visibility narrative.
sections.focusNow: Focus first on the demand contexts where JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo is consistently surfaced instead of Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo. Determine whether the relevant attributes and use cases are clearly represented across priority sources, and whether the hotel's own proposition is complete for those same contexts.
sections.whatToReview: Open the underlying displacement evidence for JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo and compare attributes cited in those answers with Radisson Hotel Santo Domingo's first-party and major travel-source representation. Confirm whether the same cues appear when the hotel is present.
